description: A scanned-synthesis oscillator: a ring of masses on springs is set moving, and a read head sweeps the ring at audio rate, reading each mass's displacement as the waveform.

params.text: Sets how many masses make up the ring, 8 to 128, which is also the length of the scanned table.
Sets the rate the read head sweeps the ring, over ±4 octaves, with the centre giving C4 at 261.63Hz.
Sets the rate of the restoring force that pulls each mass back to rest, 0.05Hz to 30Hz.
Sets the spring stiffness between neighbouring masses, 0 to 0.9, which is the main control over the timbre.
Sets how fast the ring loses energy, 0 to 1; at 0 the motion never decays.
Sets how hard an excitation kicks the ring, 0 to 1, and the gain applied to the external force.
Chooses what a trigger does: Impulse kicks one mass, Bump raises a Hann-windowed hump, Noise perturbs every mass, and Continuous ignores triggers and feeds a quiet random force.
Stops the ring physics and plays the shape held at that moment as a fixed waveform.
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the CV into the centering rate.
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the CV into the coupling stiffness.
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the CV into the damping.
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the CV into the injection amount.
Sets where around the ring the excitation and the external force enter, 0 to 100% of the way round.
Chooses Fast, which steps the ring physics once per sample, or Slow, which steps it once every 256 samples and interpolates between frames.

inputs.text: Adds to the PITCH knob at 1V per octave, setting the rate the read head sweeps the ring.
Modulates the centering rate in the log domain, a tenth of an octave per volt through its attenuverter.
Modulates the coupling stiffness, at a tenth per volt through its attenuverter.
Modulates the damping, at a tenth per volt through its attenuverter.
Modulates the injection amount, at a tenth per volt through its attenuverter.
A rising edge past 1V re-excites the ring with the shape EXCITE is set to; the edge is armed again below 0.1V, and nothing is injected while FREEZE is on.
Injects an external signal as a force at the driver mass, scaled by INJECT; a polyphonic cable is summed to mono.

outputs.text: The scanned waveform, high-passed at 20Hz and soft-clipped to ±5V.
The displacement of mass 0, a fixed point on the ring rather than the driver mass, as an audio-rate CV clamped to ±5V and not high-passed.

notes: The ring is given a full bump whenever the number of masses changes and when the module is created, so it sounds without a trigger patched.
The screen draws the masses as vertices on a circle, each pushed outward by its displacement; the orange node marks the driver mass and the sweeping dot the read head.
